claims.assertion: Yazhi describes secret power structures as compartmentalized layers, with deeper groups controlling shallower ones and limiting what each knows.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says exact participants and mechanisms are difficult to determine.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says Vatican representatives speak with Federation officials based on Saturn at the solar-system level.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She does not identify specific officials.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says groups outside Earth’s official street-level civilization use encoded gravitational transmissions called Muon, alongside other communication methods.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She lists this among several contact methods.
